HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Written policy for protecting and disposing of personal information, March 22, 2011
Owner of this policy: Jane Doe. It is reviewed every March.
Staff data sits only in the hosted KitchenGrid database, encrypted at rest. It is
not kept on laptops.
Paper records holding personal information are shredded within 30 days after they
are no longer needed.
If we learn of a breach, we tell affected customers within 72 hours.
